name: Chlorination and dechlorination
principle: Dosed chlorine (gas, hypochlorite or on-site electrochlorination) forms hypochlorous acid that inactivates pathogens; a contact basin gives the required CT (concentration x time); where chlorinated organics or aquatic toxicity matter, sulphur-dioxide or bisulphite dechlorination strips residual before discharge.

performance.basis: published CT targets at typical pH

costs.metric: annualised capital cost, chlorination plus dechlorination plus fire-code compliance
costs.basis: WERF 1995 study at 1 mgd ADWF, 5 mg/L dose: chlorination $410,000 + dechlorination $290,000 + UFC compliance $239,000 = $1,127,000; 10 mgd $3,137,000 (5 mg/L); 100 mgd $14.34M. Dechlorination adds 30-50%. O&M $49,300/yr at 1 mgd (about $0.036/m3), $158,200/yr at 10 mgd.

source.note: EPA 832-F-99-062, Chlorine Disinfection: annualised capital and O&M from the WERF 1995 study (1995-1999 USD), read 2026-11-16

costs.basis: Derived: 12.5% hypochlorite at $1.79/gal (Oct 2024 unit-price sheet) = $1.50/lb available Cl2 ($3.31/kg) assuming SG 1.20; dose 5-20 mg/L (EPA) gives 0.0166-0.066 USD/m3. Chemical only - no power, labour or dechlorination. A Dec 2023 Baytown bid ($0.2300/lb solution) gives about $0.021/m3 at 5 mg/L, an independent check.

source.note: City of Casa Grande unit-price sheet (Oct 2024): sodium hypochlorite 12.5%, bulk, $1.79/gal, read 2026-11-16
